mcpServers.description: Map of MCP server names to their configurations.

mcpServer.description: MCP server configuration. Exactly one transport must be specified: stdio (command), http/sse/ws (url).

type.description: Transport type. 'streamable-http' is accepted as an alias for 'http'.

command.description: Executable to run for stdio servers. Supports ${VAR} environment variable expansion.

args.description: Command-line arguments for stdio servers. Supports ${VAR} expansion.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the server process. Supports ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} expansion.

url.description: URL for http, sse, or ws servers. Supports ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} expansion.

headers.description: HTTP headers for remote servers. Supports ${VAR} expansion for values.
